data.subject: FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 3 x 40GP, All-in EUR 9890
data.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer below.

Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
Equipment: 3 x 40GP
Commodity: as described

All-in total: EUR 9890

The all-in total includes the following charges:
- Base ocean freight: EUR 2400 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- Terminal handling Rotterdam (THC): EUR 225 per container
- Terminal handling New York (THC): EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs clearance: EUR 45 per shipment

This quotation is valid through 2026-12-31.

To go ahead with a booking, please reply with your cargo readiness date and shipper and consignee details. If you have any questions or would like to discuss the offer, please contact us.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
